purpose: Regenerate real pre-explicit-ownership process records with the current 18.18.7 engine identity. The old producer is used unchanged except for its package version; no existing image identity or header is edited.

scenarios.legacy-b73c-owned-self-parent.image: Frameless root restore from vpid 0 to 1, then a foreground subshell blocked in hold, which produces the formerly ambiguous self-parented Proc record.
scenarios.legacy-b73c-disowned.image: A running background function is disowned by pid and externalized at hold.
scenarios.legacy-b73c-disown-all.image: A running background function is removed with disown -a and externalized at hold.
